title: Protocol to transfer epithelial acini between different extracellular matrices and orient fibril organization
protocol: Gently aspirate the medium from the well containing MCF10A acini grown on Matrigel for 10 days.
Wash the cells once with PBS using a pipette gently.
Place an 8-well chamber coverglass with the cells on ice and add 500 μL of cold cell recovery solution to each well.
Incubate the samples on ice for 30 minutes.
Gently mix the cell recovery solution and Matrigel in the chamber well 3-5 times by pipetting until Matrigel is dissociated.
Collect the mixed solution into an aliquot of cold PBS.
Add 500 μL of cold PBS to the well, then wash and collect the solution into the same tube from step 6.
Spin down the collected mixture at 1200 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant carefully, leaving a small amount behind, and re-suspend with 8-10 mL of cold PBS.
Spin down the sample at 1,200 rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the sample with 500 μL of growth medium.
Keep the resuspended sample on ice.
Add 0.2 M HEPES and 0.5 M NaOH to the resuspension and mix well.
Add collagen type 1 solution to the mixture and mix gently.
Check the pH of the collagen mixture using litmus paper and adjust it to approximately pH 7.5 if necessary.
Fill PDMS casting wells with 200–250 μL of the collagen/acini solution.
Allow the collagen to solidify in an incubator at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Put the collagen solution with acini in the incubator immediately after filling the PDMS casting wells.
Aliquot 3–5 mL of growth medium in a 6 well plate and keep in the incubator at 37°C to warm up.
Gently shake the PDMS casting wells in the medium with a tweezer and remove the collagen ring gel from the casting wells.
Carefully insert the PDMS stretching poles inside the gel hole using a tweezer.
Insert the cut pipet tip between the stretcher pole to expand the gel.
Incubate at 37°C for 4 h in the CO2 incubator.
Remove the inserted pipet tips and stretcher from the ring gel.
Transfer the stretched gel into an 8 well chamber slide.
Add 200–250 μL of collagen mixture made with growth medium to re-embed the stretched collagen gel.
Make sure that the stretched gels are completely covered by the newly added collagen solution.
Do not leave and float the stretched gel after removing the stretching poles.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min in the CO2 incubator.
Add 500 μL of growth medium for each well.
